'''2007 Illinois State Championship Brian Fred DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2007 Illinois State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I'm gonna scissor kick you in the back of the head!
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
